purgatorius.description: A small dark-furred mammal with a long bushy tail, pointed snout and round ear, climbing a mossy branch with splayed clawed feet. Behind it are dense green ferns and broad glossy leaves in a dim forest. It is painted in an oil-painting style, and the painting fills the whole square with no visible frame or text.

plesiadapis.description: A brown, furry, squirrel-like mammal with a long bushy tail clings to the side of a mossy tree trunk in a dark jungle. Its clawed hands grip the bark, its mouth is open showing small teeth, and its eyes look toward the viewer. Ferns and vines fill the background, and there is no visible text, frame or border.

eohippus-dawn-horse.description: A small, deer-like animal with a striped and spotted brown coat, slender legs, small toed feet and a pointed snout, sniffing at leaves on a forest floor. The setting is a dense, dark, humid forest with large mossy trunks, ferns and shafts of light. No letters, border, frame or violence; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

icaronycteris-early-bat.description: A bat with broad membrane wings and a long tail flies low over dark, still water at dusk, mouth open, snapping at a pale moth. Dense tropical foliage, ferns, palms and cattails frame the shore, with dark hills behind. The painting is oil-like and fills the frame edge to edge, with no text or border visible.

pakicetus.description: A dark-furred, wolf-sized mammal with a long snout, small rounded ears and a thin tail walks through shallow water at the edge of a dense, dim forest of ferns and hanging vines. Its toes are splayed on the muddy bank and the water ripples around its foot. The lighting is low and warm, with a pale glow through the trees. No text, frame or border is visible.

ambulocetus.description: A large crocodile-like animal with a long toothy snout, a small ear, a thick tail and clawed feet crouches at the edge of dark water in a mangrove swamp. Its back looks partly hairy or bristled. It is an oil painting that fills the frame, with no text, border or gore.

andrewsarchus.description: A huge shaggy dark wolf-like beast with a long heavy jaw and bared teeth walks along a dry rocky coastal cliff, with a dark sea and stormy sky behind. Oil-paint brushwork fills the whole image edge to edge. No text, frame, people or gore.

basilosaurus.description: A long, serpentine creature swims through dark blue-green water with light rays from the surface above. Its body is elongated and grey-brown with a textured, scaly look, and it curls in an S-shape. Its head is at lower right with a wide-open jaw full of sharp, pointed teeth. Small limbs or flippers appear near the tail and body, and a few small fish are faint in the background. The painting is oil-like, with visible brushstrokes, and there is no visible text, frame or border.

moeritherium.description: A stocky, grey-brown mammal with a short, trunk-like snout and two small tusks wades through dark, murky swamp water. Tall reeds, grass clumps and moss-draped trees with hanging strands frame it under misty, filtered light. The painting is oil-like and fills the whole square with no border, text or visible people.

paraceratherium.description: A large grey-brown, hornless mammal with a very long neck stretches up into a tree to strip leaves from a branch. It stands in a dim, stormy forest with dark tree silhouettes behind it. Two small hoofed animals are at the lower left and lower right for scale. The style is a dark, painterly oil-like rendering, and the painting fills the whole square with no frame, border or lettering.

aegyptopithecus.description: A dark-furred, long-tailed primate with a round face and small ears climbs along a moss-covered fallen log in a dense tropical forest. Huge buttress roots and hanging vines fill the left side, and sunlight slants through the canopy onto a river or lake in the background. No text, frame or border is visible, and the scene is calm with nothing violent.

desmostylus.description: A heavy, dark, hippo-like mammal with a thick wet hide wades through churning surf on a stormy coast. Its head is lowered to a rocky outcrop, and it is tearing at a mass of brown kelp with large forward-pointing tusk-like teeth. Dark cliffs rise behind it under a grey sky, and the painting runs edge to edge in an oil-painting style with no visible border, text or figures.

proconsul.description: A hairy, dark-furred primate with a pale face and small ears walks along a thick, moss-covered fallen branch in a dense green jungle. Shafts of yellow-green light fall through the canopy, and vines hang from the trees. The painting is an oil-style artwork that fills the whole image, with no visible text, frame or border.

gomphotherium.description: An elephant-like animal with long, curved tusks stands in a dim, dense forest, reaching up with its trunk to pull leaves from a branch. Warm light falls through the trees onto its grey-brown hide, with ferns and fallen branches in the foreground. The painting is dark and painterly and fills the frame edge to edge. A tiny, faint mark sits in the bottom-right corner, not legible as text.

merychippus.description: A brown, faintly striped horse-like animal with a mane grazes head-down in dry grass on an open plain. Three similar animals graze in the distance under a stormy sky, with flat-topped mesas and sagebrush around. It is an oil-style landscape, edge to edge, with no text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
